Plant Hardiness Zone Map for Canada

A huge part of preparedness is food. It's a good idea to store as much as possible and, if you have even a small yard, you can grow a lot of your own food too. The type of vegetables that you can grow depends on which plant hardiness zone you reside in, which basically dictates what kind of growing season and average temperatures you'll see.

Most of us here in Canada will either be in zones 3 or 4, with the exception of Halifax, southern Ontario, and western British Columbia (which get into zone 6, sometimes 7!).

This map is provided by the Government of Canada.
